description: PRE-REGISTERED (2026-10-23) BEFORE any run — docs/reports/RW-reescritura-rentable.md §13 (RW4a, quorum Q3 research priority (i): a portfolio-level exposure control that REDUCES OPEN POSITIONS, not only blocks entries, on the crypto sleeves). Mechanism (MomentumEngineConfig.exposureControl, default OFF; SimBroker.scalePosition executes the partial resizes): one sleeve-level scale λ ∈ [minScale, 1] per tick from realized BOOK vol (volCap: σ = max(σ_fast, σ_slow) of the exposure-weighted book return; λ_vol = min(1, target/σ)) and/or the RiskGuard drawdown (drawdown: linear ramp 1 → minScale between startPct and endPct of the decayed-peak dd); λ = max(minScale, min(λ_vol, λ_dd)). Each held position keeps a persisted fraction f of full size and is resized ×(λ/f) only when |λ − f| > band and the order ≥ minOrderUsd (hysteresis); reductions run even while entries are blocked, add-backs obey every entry gate and the gross cap, and never exceed full size. New entries are sized at λ. Family RW4a-c1, momentum_crypto (hourly, vt-35, correlation brake OFF — the live config since 2026-10-23, artifact efc086b4). Byte-for-byte copy of momentum-crypto-rw3-vt-35-corroff-pure-v1 (asOf pinned 2026-10-02T08:00:00Z so folds and OOS days match the control) plus the knob. ONE change vs the live config: exposureControl.drawdown {5% → 25%, floor 0.25}, band 10 pp, min order 100 USD (BTCUSDT FAPI minimum notional). At the live soft-DD threshold (10%) the book is at 0.75; at the 23.8% live max DD it sits at ~0.26. The binary soft-DD pause stays ON (it blocks entries; this trims the book). Trial 428 -> 429.CASE AGAINST (declared): (1) the live sizing already vol-targets each position (vt-35, 720 bars) and the 4% stop cuts losers — a second layer may only add turnover (every resize pays 5+4 bps per side) and sell into bottoms; (2) drawdown scaling of ENTRIES was refuted on this sleeve (ddscale 2026-09-25: 2022 lost what the pause avoided) — this candidate differs in scaling the OPEN book, but the prior is against; (3) the hourly book is 1–4 names at ≤ 0.70× gross, so there is little exposure to cut — the expected effect is small either way. CRITERIA (fixed here): the control's acceptance gates (unchanged) PLUS, against the LIVE config on the same OOS days (control artifact efc086b4 = momentum-crypto-rw3-vt-35-corroff-pure-v1, data hash 77c87d51; re-run it +0 if the hash drifts): Sharpe ≥ control (R3), maxDD ≤ control's maxDD on common days (the control is cut in drawdown, so it must not deepen it; sleeve gate 45% stays), PSR ≥ 0.95, ≥ 2/3 folds PSR > 0.5, worst LOO ≥ 0.6 × Sharpe, combined-book OOS maxDD ≤ 20% (50k/50k/5k/5k), and the extra orders (exposureStats.resizes) and extra turnover are REPORTED. Pick among passing chains: highest CAGR, ties to lower maxDD. If none passes, the sleeve stays as it is. Pure chain of 1 candidate.
